imagePullSecrets.description: also given to the DaosSystem's pods unless system.spec.imagePullSecrets is set

metricsBindAddress.description: --metrics-bind-address for the operator's own controller-runtime metrics ("0" = off)

defaultImage.description: image the operator uses when DaosSystem.spec.images.hostPrep is empty ("" = daos-hostprep next to image.repository with the operator's tag, e.g. ghcr.io/gluesys/daos-hostprep:<appVersion>)

hostprep.description: ClusterRole "daos-hostprep" that the operator binds to the per-system hostprep ServiceAccount.

enabled.description: ConfigMap with the upstream DAOS Grafana dashboard, labelled for the grafana sidecar

spec.description: DaosSystem spec, passed through as-is and validated by the CRD

system.description: Create one DaosSystem with the release. spec is passed through as-is (see api/v1alpha1 for the fields); the operator fills status.

tls.description: mount <system>-certs (agent set for the sidecar, admin set for the daos client)

nodeSelector.description: nodes that may mount DAOS PVs (default: all)

storageClasses.description: StorageClasses to create, one per DaosPool

csi.description: exastor/daos-csi: CSI driver (controller Deployment + node DaemonSet with a daos_agent sidecar). One driver per DaosSystem: csi.system names the system whose <system>-agent ConfigMap (and <system>-certs when tls) the node plugin uses.

vllm.description: vLLM serving with LMCache writing its KV cache to a DAOS container. This is a reference workload, not part of the storage layer: it is here so a GPU cluster can be brought up with one release. See doc/deploy-gpu-k8s.md. The pod runs with hostNetwork because a DAOS client must be reachable at the address it advertises; a pod-network client behind the CNI's masquerade is not (that is also why spec.clientAgent must be enabled on the GPU nodes). rdma: true is needed when DAOS runs on an RDMA provider (ofi+verbs and the like): without /dev/infiniband the client pod cannot initialise the libfabric verbs provider. On a cluster with an RDMA device plugin, prefer rdmaResource over rdma. The plugin injects only the verbs devices the pod asks for, which drops both the /dev/infiniband hostPath and privileged and leaves IPC_LOCK, at the same speed -- measured on 400G RoCE, 64 MiB round trip: 2777 MB/s write, 12162 MB/s read. If both are set, rdmaResource wins. rdmaResource: rdma/rdma_shared_device_a   # the name the NVIDIA Network Operator advertises rdmaResourceCount: 1 The vllm-lmcache-daos image in the example below lives in our internal registry only -- at 10 GB we do not mirror it publicly. The build recipe is public, so build your own: images/vllm-lmcache-daos/ in github.com/gluesys/daos-images.

s3.description: S3 gateways (versitygw-daos) in front of a DaosPool, one S3Service per entry. The operator supplies --pool/--system, the daos_agent sidecar and the certificates; see doc/adr/ADR-004-s3-gateway.md. The versitygw-daos image lives in our internal registry only: it carries a fork whose source is not public, so we do not mirror it. The build recipe is public: images/versitygw/ in github.com/gluesys/daos-images.
